desc:
A secret order built the Backrooms. Descend six floors, find a Shard of the Eye on each one, and escape before what lives down there finds you.

THE DESCENT
- The Yellow Halls: the Watcher stalks you. Never let it touch you.
- The Foundry: the Butcher hears you run.
- The Moon Garden: keep your lamp on. The Pale Lady hates the light.
- The Poolrooms: the Drowned walks out of the water.
- The Endless Hotel: the Furrier throws his knives on sight.
- The Archives: the Demon Lord waits at the Seal.

FEATURES
- Co-op squads: step into a gate with your friends and press LAUNCH
- Fall and your squad gets back up: the whole team restarts the floor together
- Proximity voice chat: whisper, they can hear you
- Hide in lockers, revive teammates, drink almond water
- Nightmare mode: one life, deadlier monsters, double rewards
- Outfits, familiars, daily descent, quests and leaderboards
- First-person view (press V)

Play with friends for +20% XP!
